name: AOL Australia
summary: America Online's Australian service; 50/50 JV with Bertelsmann announced Oct 1997, launched 1998 (dialup + AOL portal); restructured as AOL7 with Seven Network (from 2002), later Primus-AOL (2004); AOL access for Australian subscribers withdrawn 31 May 2010; AOL7 ABN cancelled 2012.

events.details: AOL Australia JV announced 7 Oct 1997 (with Bertelsmann); service launched 1998 (beta from late April 1998).
AOL dialup/broadband access withdrawn 31 May 2010; ABN cancelled 1 Jun 2012.
